name: Wise
tagline: Send money abroad at the mid-market rate
description: Moving between countries usually means moving money between currencies. Wise offers multi-currency accounts and international transfers at the real mid-market exchange rate with transparent fees, which generally makes it one of the most cost-effective options for expats, freelancers invoicing clients abroad, and anyone relocating.

name: SafetyWing
tagline: Health coverage built for nomads and remote workers
description: Most domestic health plans stop at the border, and many digital nomad visas require proof of international health coverage. SafetyWing offers subscription-style travel medical and global health insurance designed for remote workers and frequent movers, with coverage that follows you across countries.

name: FreshBooks
tagline: Invoicing, expenses, and tax-ready books for the self-employed
description: If you earn income across borders, clean books are the difference between a smooth tax filing and an expensive headache. Cloud accounting software like FreshBooks handles multi-currency invoicing, expense tracking, and tax-time reports, which generally makes working with an accountant in any country far easier.
